issue.title: difference between a imported namespace and a declared one

body:
Hrmm yes, by wrapping it you are essentially referencing it. Its a bit hard
to work out because we assume that if a selector to output is merged with a
referenced selector it should be output.

But I agree its a bug, just a difficult one to fix.

Well okay Good Luck. If i may ask: what's the reason in the first place namespaces are defined with a # prefix? as far as i understand now a namespace don't differs from a id selector. Also http://www.w3.org/TR/css3-namespace/ defines namepspaces with `@namespace`.

See the namespaces section of our website
